CustomField.description: Staging mirror of GiftTransaction.FQS_Tax_Receipt_Date__c. Rare on Gift Entry — year-end tax receipting is out of scope for FQS automation and typically handled by bulk update, not per-gift entry. Kept on the staging row for the edge case where a gift is entered retroactively with its tax receipt already issued. Written to GiftTransaction.FQS_Tax_Receipt_Date__c on commit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date this gift's tax receipt was issued to the donor. Usually filled in by an annual bulk update — enter here only if the receipt was issued before entering the gift into Salesforce.
CustomField.label: Tax Receipt Date
